load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained diffusers model from the Hugging Face Hub using AutoModel.from_pretrained with a model id
load_model_from_config: instantiate a diffusers model from a config dictionary or path using AutoModel.from_config with random weights
load_unet_from_pretrained: load a UNet model from a stable diffusion checkpoint using AutoModel.from_pretrained with a subfolder argument
load_model_with_trust_remote_code: load a diffusers model with custom remote code using AutoModel.from_pretrained and trust_remote_code set to True
load_transformers_model: load a transformers model via AutoModel.from_pretrained when the config contains a model_type key
